title: Interaction surface renderer
summary: The editor's one renderer for interaction surfaces a Luc opens (lumeri.interaction/v1). Packages run no code here: they describe a surface with the canonical primitives and the editor draws it, previews it on the canvas and submits the creator's result, through the native confirmation bridge where the App offers one.

carrier.notes: static/v3/luc-ui.js (window.LumeriLucUI). The relay on the Runtime side is iface:luc.interaction-relay/v1 (machinery area).

replaceability.why: It turns a Luc's request into the creator's confirmation, and on the App it carries the native confirmation bridge; replacing it would let a Luc confirm for the creator.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (the editor page shell and its native bridge); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:98

operations.name: GET /sessions/{session_id}/luc/interactions/current
operations.notes: Read again on reconnect to restore an open interaction.

operations.name: POST /sessions/{session_id}/luc/interactions/{interaction_id}/result
operations.notes: Each submission carries a submission_id and draft_revision; a lost reply is retried with the identical submission while it is still the newest draft. A completed result for an interaction that writes the Project needs a confirmation token from the native bridge lumeriLucConfirmation; without that bridge it is not sent, and a native cancel becomes a cancelled submission. On the listed refusals the renderer restores the current interaction.

invariants.text: A refused confirmation hands the controls back.
Retrying a lost reply replays the identical submission.
Retrying after a newer draft sends the current values as a new submission.

break: a surface cannot be drawn or submitted
failure.notes: Nothing is applied without the creator's submission; the interaction stays open or is cancelled.

conformance.notes: The primitives are docs/luc/schemas/interaction-primitives-v1.schema.json; no test checks the renderer draws each one.
